info.description:
Go backend boilerplate using Clean Architecture: auth, RBAC and a worked CRUD example.

Every JSON response uses one envelope: `success`, `message`, and on an error a stable snake_case `code`, which is what clients branch on. `data` and `meta` carry results, and `errors` carries validation details. Every response echoes `X-Request-ID`.

Any route can also answer 413 (body larger than server.body_limit) and 500 (generic message, details only in the server log).

Some routes depend on the configuration: the email routes exist only with auth.email.enabled, the partner routes only when an API key is configured, and /metrics only with OpenTelemetry enabled.

post.description: Always answers 200 with the same message, whether or not the address is registered. Available only when auth.email.enabled is true.
Answers the tokens, the user, and their menus and permissions. Accounts lock after repeated failures (401 account_locked).

post.description: Rotates the refresh token, which travels per auth.refresh_transport: in the Authorization header as Bearer (body mode), or in the HttpOnly cookie (cookie mode). Access tokens are refused here.

403.description: Cookie mode only: the request came from an origin that is not allowed

post.description: With auth.email.enabled, an address that is already registered gets the same 201 as a new one and its owner is emailed instead, so the response never says which addresses have accounts. Without email, a taken address is 409 email_already_registered.

409.description: email_already_registered, only when auth.email.enabled is false

post.description: Signs the account out on every device. Available only when auth.email.enabled is true.
post.summary: Reset the password with an emailed token

400.description: validation_failed, a password the policy refuses, or invalid_reset_token

post.description: Always answers 200 with the same message: for an unknown, disabled or already verified address nothing is sent. A code is also sent automatically after registration. Available only when auth.email.enabled is true.
Unauthenticated, so it works while auth.require_email_verification refuses login. Each code tolerates auth.otp.max_attempts guesses. Available only when auth.email.enabled is true.
post.summary: Verify an email address with the emailed code

get.description: Paginated: data is the array, and the page counters are in meta. An out-of-range page or limit is clamped, not rejected.

403.description: The caller lacks the bar list permission

post.description: code must start with EXP (400 bar_code_invalid) and be unique (409 bar_code_already_exists). Retrying with the same Idempotency-Key replays the first response with Idempotency-Replayed: true.

parameters.description: Unique per logical request, at most 255 characters
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

403.description: The caller lacks the bar create permission

409.description: bar_code_already_exists, or a request with this Idempotency-Key is still being processed

422.description: Idempotency-Key reused with a different payload

get.description: A bar that does not exist is 404.

403.description: The caller lacks the bar get permission

put.description: Replaces the bar's content. code may be omitted or repeated but not changed: it is the business key (400 bar_code_immutable).

403.description: The caller lacks the bar update permission

delete.description: Soft deletes the bar. Repeating the call is 404.

403.description: The caller lacks the bar delete permission

post.description: Requires the current password. Answers 200 with the same message whether or not the address is free; a code is sent only when it is. Available only when auth.email.enabled is true.
post.summary: Start changing the account's email address

post.description: The old address is told once the change is made. Available only when auth.email.enabled is true.
post.summary: Confirm an email change with the code sent to the new address

409.description: email_already_registered: the address was taken since the code was sent

put.description: Requires the current password. Revokes every other session; the caller stays signed in.

get.description: Active, unexpired sessions of the caller, most recently used first. The session making the request has current=true.

delete.description: Signs out one device. A session that does not exist, is already revoked, or belongs to someone else is 404 — the three are indistinguishable on purpose.

BearerAuth.description: JWT access token. On /api/v1/auth/refresh, the refresh token instead.

InternalSecret.description: Required only when internal_auth.mode=shared_secret. Otherwise the header is ignored.
InternalSecret.name: X-Internal-Secret

RefreshCookie.description: Refresh token cookie when auth.refresh_transport=cookie. The name is __Secure-refresh_token outside local/dev/development/test.
RefreshCookie.name: refresh_token

current.description:
Current marks the session the request was made with, so a client can label it "this
device" and avoid offering to revoke it.

code.description:
Code is set on every error: a stable, machine-readable, snake_case identifier. Clients
branch on it (and on the status); Message is prose for humans and may change.
